allow: PowerShell($ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Write-Output "=== health ==="; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:9989/health' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Output $r.Content } catch { Write-Output "STATUS: $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__\)"; $s=$_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream\(\); $rd=New-Object IO.StreamReader\($s\); Write-Output $rd.ReadToEnd\(\) }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== client ==="; try { $c = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:4173/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output "STATUS: $\($c.StatusCode\) len=$\($c.Content.Length\)" } catch { Write-Output "CLIENT ERR: $_" })
